label: YouTube Shorts

sources.covers: Shorts are up to 3 minutes and need a square or vertical aspect ratio (uploads from 15 Oct 2024); wider videos stay long-form
recommended upload encoding: MP4 with moov at the front, H.264 progressive 4:2:0, closed GOP, AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo, ~8 Mbps for 1080p (12 Mbps at 48-60 fps)
1080x1920 recommended, playback capped at 1080p; codecs H.264/H.265/VP9 (creator guidance)
safe-zone margins at 1080x1920: top 288, bottom 672, left 48, right 192 (derived from ad guidance)

source_note: Length and aspect are official (YouTube Help). Encoding values are YouTube's recommended upload settings (recommendations, not hard limits). YouTube publishes no Shorts safe zones: ui (FAIL) is the area the title, channel row, subscribe button and action column always cover; ui_caution (WARN) is the more conservative creator guidance where a long title or the description can reach. rec_dur is creator guidance.

video.moov_note: YouTube recommends it at the front (ffmpeg -movflags +faststart)
